about: SCION 34 · ARAP: every asset in the film, where it came from, its rights and the operation that made it.

assets.what: the dog in profile: torso, neck, four legs (shoulder and thigh masses), tail; an engraving (ink lines on paper) whose hatch follows each part (lengthwise on the barrel, along the limbs, bunched at their edges as on a cylinder) and whose line width follows a computed light
assets.source: drawn in code: build/draw_dog.py (P_body) + build/engrave.py; proportions after the archive dog's rig keys (kit/archive-dog/pose_agent_v8.json, looked at as numbers only)

assets.what: the dog's head in profile with pricked ears, eye, dark muzzle, nose: its own mesh riding the neck; eye and nose are protected features (rigidity weight 30); mirrored (a reflected rest shape) when it looks over its shoulder
rear view (haunches, tail, hind legs, the back receding) and the back of the head: substitution key for the turn away
front view with the head turned a quarter toward the door: substitution key for the turn back
a woman in a long smock with her hair in a bun, in profile (standing, seated) and her near arm as its own mesh; no face is portrayed beyond a profile line
assets.source: drawn in code: build/draw_person.py; the figure is suggested by the woman in kit/archive-door (Straight Talk, 1992, NTIS, public domain, https://archive.org/details/gov.ntis.ava19144vnb1), who is seen only from behind there; no pixels of that footage are used

assets.what: the cutaway: the wall cut at the door (poche), the far jamb, the sill, the door leaf, the room with a lamp, a picture and a stool, the porch boards, posts, the far railing, the eave, the dusk sky
assets.operation: synthesized engraving (ruled lines), lit per frame by a computed light map
